title: Learning reminder content-capability request
description: Exact wire contract accepted by "TitulinoApi_v1"."ReplaceLearningContentCapabilities"(jsonb), which forwards verbatim to "Notification".replace_learning_content_capabilities(jsonb). See titulino-warehouse deploy/Notification/2026/09/28_learning_reminder_functions.sql for the authoritative parser this schema mirrors.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this JSON contract itself (not the manifest content). Bump when a field is added/removed/reinterpreted.

manifestKey.description: Identifies the replaceable set. Every existing row under this key is marked IsAvailable=false before the items in this request are applied, then re-affirmed/upserted -- this is the stale/removal mechanism. Use one manifestKey per atomically-replaceable publish unit.

manifestVersion.description: Free-text content revision recorded on every row touched by this publish (NotificationContentCapability.ManifestVersion). Recommended convention: YYYY.MM.DD-n.

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp stored as NotificationContentCapability.PublishedAt. The publisher (Phase 2A/Worker) should set this to the actual call time, not a value frozen in this source file, unless the product intent is specifically to record content-authored-at.

sourceAudit.description: Non-authoritative provenance metadata for reviewers. Not read by the database function.

courseTheme.description: Exact course theme key (Enrollment.Course.CourseDetails->>'courseTheme' convention), e.g. "english-connect-1", "meditaciones", "speeches". Never derive from a translated title.

courseCodeId.description: Null = theme-level (applies to every CourseCodeId under this theme). Set only when a specific cohort's content/calendar has been individually verified -- see cohortCalendarLimitations in schedule-anchors.json.

featureKey.description: Must reference an existing Shop.CourseFeature row and match the RuleDefinition.FeatureKey of the rule this capability gates, e.g. "course-feature.submenu.quizlet", "course-feature.submenu.know-me".

chapterNumber.description: The DB stores this as text-matched against ^[0-9]{1,3}$ before casting to int4; always publish a plain non-negative integer, chapterNumber 0 excepted only for class-0/category-4 style targets which use a different rule shape than these two rules.

contentLanguageCode.description: Must equal the exact language the content teaches, matched against Enrollment.Course.TargetLanguageId at evaluation time.

nativeLanguageCode.description: Matched against Enrollment.Course.NativeLanguageId, or '*' (the DB default) to match any native language. Prefer an explicit code over '*' whenever content genuinely differs per native-language pairing (e.g. separate Quizlet folders per pairing), even if the current chapter count happens to be identical -- this preserves the pairing distinction the plan requires and avoids masking a future divergence.

baseLanguages.description: Repo-convention mirror of nativeLanguageCode as an array (matches the baseLanguages/contentLanguageCode pairing used throughout titulino-bucket/titulino-spine-data and enforced by bucket-scripts/validate-data-shape.js). Not read by the database function; keep in sync with nativeLanguageCode.

level.description: 0 matches any proficiency level (DB: Level IN (0, COALESCE(target_level, source_level, 0))). Set explicitly only for genuine level-specific content variants (e.g. Basic vs Advanced Grammar).

relativePath.description: Optional. Must start with exactly one '/', never '//' or contain '://'. Do not publish an absolute titulino.com URL here or anywhere in this manifest -- the actual student-facing route is resolved at send/open time from live navigation metadata (locale, level, chapter), which this manifest cannot know in advance. Recommended: leave null and let this item act purely as a content-existence gate.

templateKey.description: Free-text cross-reference, e.g. the RuleKey this item supports. Not validated against RuleDefinition by the database.

contentHash.description: Fingerprint of the exact verified source content (e.g. Quizlet course id, or survey question id list) so a future re-generation can detect drift without re-deriving the whole item.

isAvailable.description: false publishes the identity as explicitly withdrawn/unavailable (e.g. content verified NOT to exist, or a path pending manual validation) rather than omitting it -- omission after a prior publish also sets IsAvailable=false for anything not re-affirmed under the same manifestKey, but an explicit false plus a metadata.exclusionReason documents WHY.

metadata.description: Additive, non-authoritative context. This project's convention: sourceCategoryId (1, 2, or 4), plus provenance fields such as quizletFolderId/quizletCourseId or questionCount, plus exclusionReason when isAvailable is false.
